Under the supervision of the Division Administrator and Division Chief, incumbent will provide clerical and administrative support to the Division of Nephrology, Hypertension and Kidney Transplantation. Responsibilities to include front office functions: answering, screening, and directing incoming telephone calls, facsimiles, and mail; scheduling appointments and maintaining faculty calendars, as directed; coordinating various aspects related to Divisional conferences and programs; and inputting and updating Division on-call schedule, to name a few. Additional financial functions to include: compiling documentation and appropriate justification needed for reimbursements, processing transactions related to business expenses, and purchasing and maintaining an inventory of office supplies for the Division. Will also coordinate activities related to Academic Personnel, such as: academic actions and appointments. Other duties as assigned.
Highly attentive to proper handling of confidential information and documents.
Ability to operate a networked PC in a Windows environment with proficiency in MS Word, Outlook, and Excel, with fast and accurate data entry skills.
Knowledge of UCI/UCIMC departments, personnel, and locations.
Clear and professional communication skills, written and verbal.
Knowledge of UCI Academic Personnel policies and procedures.
Ability to organize and prioritize workload.
Knowledge of UCI policies and procedures.
Excellent interpersonal skills; will interact with a wide variety of people including patients, students, staff, and faculty.
